title: Jeska Becomes Phage
summary: Dark Cabal intervention remakes the wounded Jeska as Phage the Untouchable, whose touch brings death.
narrative: Jeska did not recover from the injury caused by Kamahl's Mirari sword. The Cabal's intervention transformed her into Phage rather than restoring her original condition.
Her deadly power became central to the arena culture and political designs of the Cabal Patriarch, drawing her into new conflicts across Otaria.
